direction.name: 海风玩具渔市
direction.summary: 原创圆润小海獭与彩色海滩鲜货摊，使用低细节、高辨识的平面图形
direction.characterStyle: 用圆头、小圆耳、浅色口鼻和短扁尾构成的原创小海獭，不模仿任何已有角色
direction.environmentStyle: 9:16 竖屏顶视沙滩，纵向组织浅海、木制码头、冰盘和帆布摊位；锁定潮池同时承担投币建设，解锁后原地变为采集点，禁止额外海带建设区
direction.uiStyle: 深海蓝半透明胶囊面板配米白文字和珊瑚色数字；主角满载时显示原创珊瑚色‘满载’徽标，正常位于货物堆上方，遇 HUD 排斥区时切换到仍贴近主角的安全侧位
direction.iconConcept: 一只原创小海獭抱着蓝色鲜鱼篮，背后是抽象海浪和遮阳蓬
direction.previewPrompt: Original portrait mobile game art direction sheet for a top-down beach seafood shop run by a cute original sea otter, one locked tide-pool that becomes a kelp source after local investment, fish kelp and shrimp products, no logos, no resemblance to any existing game

kept: generic fish, kelp and shrimp products
changes: Merge kelp investment and harvesting into one tide-pool spatial node
Remove the separate lower-right kelp construction zone
Keep construction.invested only as compatible saved progress
Resolve 满载 marker placement against HUD exclusion rectangles while keeping it attached to the player
notes: This seaside-v3 style lock supersedes seaside-v2 without modifying archived artifacts
This is a functional vertical-slice style lock, not final production art
Favor one location per interaction purpose and local readable feedback
